mintAuthority.summary: USDH has one canonical native issuance deployment on HyperEVM. Bridge Building, Inc. controls issuer-direct minting through the USDH MINTER_ROLE and reserve-ledger handler, while two DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOAs can authorize minters, raise the on-chain cap, and authorize UUPS upgrades. The HyperCore HIP-1 asset is a linked representation of this deployment and is excluded from Mint Authority.

controls.label: Bridge (Stripe) issuance backend
controls.evidence: Bridge Building, Inc. operates the 1:1 mint/redeem for USDH against high-quality liquid reserves; supply is created by the issuer backend rather than any permissionless or user-collateralized route.

controls.label: USDH HyperEVM MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 43375036, MINTER_ROLE on the USDH proxy had EOA member 0x19810813f2e46cf01e7c543f6d8c3ecc8ea2001e. The verified implementation requires MINTER_ROLE, approved recipients, and totalSupply + amount <= getMaxSupply(); the separate DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE controls setMaxSupply and upgrade authorization.

controls.label: USDH ReserveLedgerBackedHandler MINTER_ROLE
controls.capDescription: The USDH contract enforced totalSupply + amount <= getMaxSupply(), observed at 250,000,000 USDH on 2026-08-16; the handler cannot change that cap.
controls.evidence: The verified ReserveLedgerBackedHandler is a USDH MINTER_ROLE member and implements the issuer-native reserve-ledger flow: it mints reserve-ledger tokens into its reserve store and calls the USDH contract mint function; burning reverses that flow. It is native issuer accounting, not a cross-chain bridge. Its exact TokenAuthority allowance and transaction mint-limit values remain unverified.

controls.label: USDH HyperEVM DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA 0x178a0f2ad20e2abefe2cb86e4fc2db412edfb3b9
controls.capDescription: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can setMaxSupply; getMaxSupply() was 250,000,000 USDH at the observation block, so the cap is raiseable.
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 43375036, EOA 0x178a0f2ad20e2abefe2cb86e4fc2db412edfb3b9 held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the USDH proxy. The verified implementation makes administration able to authorize MINTER_ROLE members, setMaxSupply, and authorize the UUPS upgrade path; no delay was observed.

controls.label: USDH HyperEVM DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA 0x79c6631fa15cda38777fb9dd7a6348baee794a4e
controls.capDescription: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can setMaxSupply; getMaxSupply() was 250,000,000 USDH at the observation block, so the cap is raiseable.
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 43375036, EOA 0x79c6631fa15cda38777fb9dd7a6348baee794a4e held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the USDH proxy. The verified implementation makes administration able to authorize MINTER_ROLE members, setMaxSupply, and authorize the UUPS upgrade path; no delay was observed.

controls.label: USDH TokenAuthority handler registry
controls.capDescription: TokenAuthority authorizes registered stablecoin handlers and their limits; the USDH-specific allowance and transaction mint-limit values were not independently decoded.
controls.evidence: The verified TokenAuthority is the issuer control plane for registered stablecoin handlers and limits, including the USDH ReserveLedgerBackedHandler. It belongs to the native issuer path and is not a bridge adapter or cross-chain representation controller.

review.evidence: At HyperEVM block 43375036 on 2026-08-16, the canonical USDH proxy had MINTER_ROLE members EOA 0x19810813f2e46cf01e7c543f6d8c3ecc8ea2001e and ReserveLedgerBackedHandler 0x6fb239a92d3a7b2b9898c13cdedd2bc26e323ec2. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE had EOAs 0x178a0f2ad20e2abefe2cb86e4fc2db412edfb3b9 and 0x79c6631fa15cda38777fb9dd7a6348baee794a4e. The verified UUPS implementation was 0x0be1d5d7c5f9b8784fbf341c4c4a1eb732d4a7f9, the observed getMaxSupply() was 250,000,000 USDH, and no upgrade delay was observed. Bridge Building's reserve-ledger handler is native issuance; HyperCore token index 360 is a linked representation and is not global Mint Authority. Monthly BPM LLP attestations support periodic reconciliation, while no product-specific prudential authorization was verified.
